title: Baked Mediterranean Artichoke
description: A keto-friendly side dish featuring roasted artichoke with a hint of Mediterranean flavors.
instructions: Rinse the artichoke and pat dry.
Cut the top off the artichoke and remove the tough outer leaves.
In a bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, and Mediterranean seasoning.
Brush the mixture onto the artichoke, making sure to get some under the leaves.
Place the artichoke on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until tender.
Remove from oven and top with crumbled feta cheese.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
